# Test fixture attributions

Run `bash fetch.sh` in this directory to download the images below. Nothing
here is committed — only this file and `fetch.sh` live in git.

## Public domain (no attribution required, but noted for provenance)

| File                  | Source                                                                | License / rationale                                                    |
|-----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `girl_pearl.jpg`      | Vermeer, *Girl with a Pearl Earring* (c. 1665), Mauritshuis           | PD-old-100 (author d. 1675). Wikimedia file `1665_Girl_with_a_Pearl_Earring.jpg` |
| `mona_lisa.jpg`       | Leonardo da Vinci, *Mona Lisa* (c. 1503–1506), Louvre                 | PD-old-100 (author d. 1519). Wikimedia file `Mona_Lisa,_by_Leonardo_da_Vinci,_from_C2RMF_retouched.jpg` |
| `great_wave.jpg`      | Hokusai, *The Great Wave off Kanagawa* (c. 1831)                      | PD-old-100 (author d. 1849). Wikimedia file `Tsunami_by_hokusai_19th_century.jpg` |
| `starry_night.jpg`    | Van Gogh, *The Starry Night* (1889), MoMA                             | PD-old-100 (author d. 1890). Wikimedia file `Van_Gogh_-_Starry_Night_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg` |
| `van_gogh_self.jpg`   | Van Gogh, *Self-Portrait* (1889), Musée d'Orsay                       | PD-old-100. Wikimedia file `Vincent_van_Gogh_-_Self-Portrait_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg` |

Wikimedia's position: faithful 2D reproductions of PD works are PD.

Gregory H. Revera and note the CC BY-SA 3.0 license. Internal test use
requires no attribution.

## Reused from `examples/` in this repo (not downloaded)

- `examples/einstein.png` — used as the grayscale portrait baseline.
- `examples/david.gif` frame 0 — used as the dark-on-light shadow fixture.
- `examples/eye.png` — used as a small subject scaling case.

Copy or symlink into this directory before running tests, or point the
harness config directly at `examples/`.

## Synthetic fixtures — generated by the test harness

Not stored. `test_baseline.jl` builds:

- `checker(N)` — axis-aligned checkerboard.
- `gradient(N)` — horizontal grayscale ramp.
- `radial(N)` — radial gradient from center.
- `text(N)` — rendered text if `FreeTypeAbstraction` available.
